(PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD)
1.

This appeal under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act')
has been filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 17.08.2011 passed by Fast Track Court - I, Dharwad in M.V.C. No.737/2005.
2.

Facts giving rise to the filing of the appeal briefly stated are that on 23.02.2005 at about 11:50 p.m., when the appellant - claimant was sleeping near their petty shop in Ulavi Jatra at Ulavi, at that time, the driver of passenger auto bearing No.MH-03/J-8841 drove the same in rash and negligent manner and drove the same on appellant and caused the accident.
Due to the said accident, the claimant sustained mal- united fracture of clavicle bone and sustained the disability at 9% to upper limb.
After the accident, the claimant took treatment in KIMS Hospital, Hubballi and thereafter in Government hospital at Navalgund for eight days.
3. The claimant filed a petition under Section 166 of the Act, seeking compensation.
It was pleaded that she spent significant amount towards medical expenses, conveyance NC: 2024:KHC-D:17974 charges and other related costs.
It was further pleaded that the accident occurred solely on account of rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle by its driver.
4. Upon service of notice, the respondents appeared through counsel and filed written statement denying the averments made in the claim petition.
The respondent No.1 - driver, despite service of notice, did not appear before the Tribunal and was placed ex-parte.

5. On the basis of the pleadings of the parties, the Claims Tribunal framed the issues and thereafter,
recorded the evidence.

The Tribunal, by impugned judgment and award has partly allowed the claim petition and held that the claimant is entitled to a compensation of Rs.51,500/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum and directed the insurance company to deposit the compensation amount along with interest.
Being aggrieved, the present appeal has been filed.
6. The learned counsel for the appellant - claimant contended that the Tribunal has fastened the liability on owner of the vehicle on the ground that the insured has violated the policy condition.
He Mallavva W/O. Ramanna Kumkumgar vs Mehaboobbaig S/O. Fakkirabaig Belgaum on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99056265/

3 further contended that in the connected NC: 2024:KHC-D:17974 matter, this Court in M.F.A.
No.20474/2012 disposed off on 21.04.2021 arising out of the same accident has passed an order directing the insurance company to pay the compensation amount with liberty to recover from the owner of the offending vehicle.
To that effect the learned counsel sought for modification of the judgment and award.
7. The learned counsel for the insurance company has not disputed with the order passed by this Court in M.F.A. No.20474/2012 disposed off on 21.04.2021.

8. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the judgment and award of the Tribunal and the order of this Court passed in M.F.A. No.20474/2012.
9.
There is no dispute with regard to the accident that occurred on 23.02.2005 and the claimant sustaining injuries in the said accident.
However, the issue is only with regard to the compensation to be paid by the owner of the offending vehicle or the insurance company.

In view of the judgment passed in M.F.A. No.20474/2012 disposed off on 21.04.2021, the insurance company is liable to pay the compensation amount of Rs.51,500/- awarded by the Tribunal and then the insurance NC:
2024:KHC-D:17974 company shall recover the same with the owner of the offending vehicle.

10. In view of the above, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed in part.
ii. The judgment and award dated 17.08.2011 passed by the Fast Track Court - I, Dharwad passed in M.V.C. No.737/2005 is modified.

iii. The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the compensation amount of Rs.51,500/- along with interest @ 6% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition till the date of realization, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this judgment.
 iv. The Insurance Company shall recover the  compensation amount from owner of the  offending vehicle.
In view of the order dated 09.12.2024 passed by this Court, the claimant is not entitled to interest on the enhanced compensation for the delayed period of 2542 days in filing the appeal.
